name: Hulun-Kesh
backstory: He guards the streets by night in his turn with the city levy. He lodges with the boatwoman's household.

name: Okaw-Neesa
backstory: She is the mother of Poles-Upriver and knots fishing nets for the city's river fishers. She poled rafts herself until her grip failed.

name: Nuexa-Lei
backstory: She cleans, sorts and bundles the fellrunner feathers that the hunters of Murkwood bring to the household's stall.

name: Lumeexa
backstory: She gathers lumberries in Last Seed and cooks for the pilgrims who lodge with her household.

name: Jeenaxi
backstory: She tends the eggs in the city's nest-pools and records every clutch with its parents and its hatch date.

name: Lieshu
backstory: She gathers herbs and roots in the swamp around the city for the household's stall.

name: Gahzeel
backstory: He guards the streets by night for the levy and sleeps at its camp. He has no kin in the city.

name: Nine-Teeth
backstory: She lost nine teeth in a fight on the plank walks and has been called Nine-Teeth since. She guards the streets by night for the levy.

name: Ruweel-Ta
backstory: He walks the day watch of the city levy and lodges with the trader's household. He stops outsiders at the landing and does not explain why.

name: Jeelixus
backstory: He nets trodh in the shallows of the river fork and sells them live at the market. Cooked trodh is poison, so his buyers eat them on the spot.

name: Paxu-Lei
backstory: She grooms scales and polishes spines for customers who can pay. She works from a mat beside the market.

name: Neeshal
backstory: He tans hides at the smithy's rack and cuts leather straps for his partner's fittings.

name: Ulaxeen
backstory: She poles a flat raft between the districts of the city with goods from the landing.

name: Xuhal-Teeus
backstory: He builds the rafts for his partner's trade, lashing cane and sealing the joints with Hist-sap resin.

name: Wexa-Dun
backstory: She plays the frog pipes at the city's gatherings. She keeps her frogs fat and well fed for a better tone.

name: Tzalun
trade: the city levy, leads the day watch
backstory: He is the oldest of the levy at the camp and leads the day watch. He settles quarrels among the guards before the naheesh hear of them.

name: Sleeps-Last
backstory: He keeps the boatmen's lodge, where raft crews and the few outsiders eat and sleep. The crews named him for being the last awake in the lodge each night.

name: Weetsa
backstory: She gathers marsh-bird eggs in the forest around the city for the household's stall. She goes out at first light and is back before the market opens.

name: Deetsa-Hul
backstory: She hauls cargo from the rafts to the market stalls. In the pilgrim season she works from first light until after dark.

name: Hixee-Ra
backstory: She is a naheesh and sits with the city's assembly of elders and tree-minders. She knows the sacred croaks of the Root Talk by heart.

name: Oleeka-Tsun
backstory: She carves depth sticks and sells them to visitors who do not know the city's pools.

name: Saxeena
backstory: She mends the plank walks between the districts and replaces the boards that have rotted in the wet.

name: Shuxeeta
backstory: She unloads rafts at the landing and carries the goods to the households. The naheesh of the assembly set the share that each household receives.

name: Wujeel
trade: sap and herb seller; teaches alchemy
backstory: He sells Hist-sap and swamp herbs from a stall with an alchemy bench and teaches the craft to apprentices who can pay. Sap is dear in Helstrom, because the tree-minders allow little to be taken.

name: Huzeel-Tan
backstory: He carves the grave-stakes that the city's grave-singers set over the dead.

name: Bexeeh-Tul
backstory: He works the bellows and the grindstone at the smithy and is learning the forge from his father.

name: Cheeval-Xu
trade: rootworm handler at the root landing
backstory: He keeps the root landing, where travellers climb down to board the rootworms. He knows each worm's temper and its route.

name: Xilsa-Jee
backstory: She is learning the tree-minder's work from her mother. She clears rot and creepers from the roots of the grove.

name: Ekaneesh
backstory: She is a grave-singer. She stakes the city's dead and sings the final song over them.

name: Counts-Twice
trade: market trader in Murkwood feathers, sap, eggs and river fish
backstory: She buys from the raft crews and the rootworm riders and sells Murkwood feathers, sap, eggs and river fish from her market stall. Outsiders named her for the way in which she counts their coin.

name: Taxeel-Wan
trade: fisher; serves turns in the levy
backstory: He fishes with his mother between his turns in the levy. He serves his next turn in Hist-Tsoko, when pilgrims crowd the city.

name: Juxee-Meen
backstory: She pickles frog's eyes for the market. In Helstrom they are a delicacy and a cure for a sour stomach.

name: Raxeela-Hut
backstory: She serves the day watch of the levy and lodges with the tally-keeper's household. At the landing she searches every outsider's pack.

name: Peeshal-Ru
backstory: He spears fish in the deep water at the river fork and sells his catch at the market.

name: Nolu-Jeel
backstory: He builds the plank walks and stilt footings between the districts of the city. He also trains living wood into walkway posts, which takes years.

name: Heeshu
backstory: She collects the sap that the tree-minders release for sale and carries it home in sealed gourds.

name: Ohanga-Tsei
backstory: She poled rafts on the Panther River for most of her life. Now she mends nets on the household's landing.

name: Meeja-Tsoi
backstory: She meets the pilgrims who come for the Root Talk in Hist-Tsoko and finds them floor space in the city. Out of season she hires out as a river guide.

name: Jeetsa-Rin
backstory: She dyes leather tail bands and stitches bells onto them for the market.

name: Nuxeeka
backstory: She traps fellrunners in Murkwood for their feathers and sells them to the stalls at the market.

name: Uxal-Dee
backstory: He guards the streets by night for the city levy and lodges at the smith's house. The smith sharpens his blade for nothing.

name: Sakka-Zuul
backstory: He serves the day watch of the levy and lodges with the sap-seller. He was a raftsman before his tribe sent him to serve his turn.

name: Tsiraxi
backstory: She fishes the river fork from a one-person raft and sells her catch at the market.

name: Ajum-Teel
trade: maker of fleshfly emollient and scale balm
backstory: He boils fleshfly emollient and scale balms for the stall. He sells most of them to raft crews before the flesh-fly season.

name: Eleexa-Bur
backstory: She digs black Heart-Mud from the pools between the roots and packs it into the walls of the city's houses.

name: Ooxa-Leet
backstory: She is a naheesh of the assembly and holds the naming secrets of the Chukka-Sei. She gives the city's young their names at their maturity trials.

name: Heetaxi
backstory: He seals roofs and raft seams with Hist-sap resin. He works in the dry spells and sits idle through the monsoon.

name: Kassa-Weel
backstory: She owes a season of labour to a household that she wronged, by the ruling of the assembly's naheesh. She carries loads at the landing and keeps nothing of her pay until the season ends.

name: Weesha-Lun
backstory: She weaves baskets and egg crates from cane for the market traders.

name: Meshu-Ka
trade: Root-Folk smith at the market smithy
backstory: He works the forge at the market smithy with iron bought from the raft crews. The levy and the raft crews buy his blades and fittings and pay him well in goods.

name: Zeexa-Num
backstory: She catches chirping frogs on the Panther River fork and sells them by their tone to the makers of frog pipes.

name: Ixtul-Bei
trade: tally-keeper of goods landed for the assembly
backstory: He writes down the goods landed at the river fork for the naheesh of the assembly, who share them out among the households. He has kept the house alone since his partner died.

name: Tsaxi-Rei
backstory: He rides the rootworms through the tunnels of the Hist roots to the villages of the basin. He brings back orders for the stall.

name: Taleeka-Ma
trade: tree-minder and healer; sells Restoration and Alteration tomes
backstory: She is a tree-minder of the city grove and heals the sick at the tree-minders' hall. She sells tomes of Restoration and Alteration and teaches healing to those who ask.

name: Kuxeesh
backstory: He takes in pilgrims for the Root Talk through the month of Hist-Tsoko. The rest of the year he fishes the river.

name: Weeruk-Ta
backstory: He cuts and shapes bark shingles for the city's roofs. He learned the trade on his father's crew.

name: Ruxa-Neel
backstory: She carries river water to the houses near the market in the weeks when the city spring is left untouched. She does not discuss the reason with outsiders.

name: Poles-Upriver
trade: raft-boatman to Truowa, Korydon, Marzai and Julo
backstory: She poles a cargo raft from Helstrom to the river villages of Truowa, Korydon, Marzai and Julo. Her passengers could not say her Jel name, so she answers to the name that they gave her.
